cli.about: Deterministic SDD capabilities for LLM hosts and Skills; never starts agents
arg.lang: Override the detected interface language, for example zh-CN or en-US.
arg.path: Repository directory (also accepted after a subcommand).
arg.framework: Select the repository's native SDD framework.
arg.format: Select the output format for native capabilities.
arg.view: Choose compact agent output or the full result.
arg.fields: Comma-separated fields to include in structured results.
arg.offset: Number of items to skip when paging results.
arg.all_worktrees: Include all worktrees in the repository progress view.
command.inspect: Inspect native providers, artifacts and structured project state.
command.progress: Read progress across every worktree in the common Git repository.
command.prepare: Prepare complete work packets; the calling host owns agent execution.
command.next: Preview ready work and blockers without allocating or executing anything.
command.apply_result: Accept a host receipt, verify/integrate it and prepare subsequent work.
command.archive: Preview a native archive; use --apply --plan-hash to execute it.
command.doctor: Read configuration, state and repair diagnostics; never starts a model.
command.tools: Discover or call granular tools through structured JSON arguments.
command.init: Bind Skills and optionally an owned MCP entry to the existing SDD host.
command.mcp: Serve the same capabilities as stdio MCP tools/resources.
command.providers: Inspect, install and run native OpenSpec / Spec Kit tools.
command.help: Display help for a command or nested subcommand.
command.providers_status: Read tool versions and installation readiness without downloads.
command.providers_ensure: Install missing selected tools and prerequisites in a user-owned directory.
command.providers_exec: Run a native tool; put its arguments after --.
option.managed: Use the isolated managed version instead of an existing command.
option.provider: Initialize the selected native SDD framework when missing.
error.selection_required: A framework or phase selection is required
error.provider_offline: The provider is missing while offline mode is enabled
error.provider_unusable: The configured provider is not usable
error.git_binary_unavailable: No binary is published for this platform
error.git_binary_offline: The binary is not cached while offline mode is enabled
error.git_binary_version_mismatch: The downloaded binary version is incorrect
